analysis.title: Cross-Asset Technical Strategy 2027 Year-Ahead Outlook— Intently Watching the Weather Vane
key_insights: Cross-asset technical setup into 2027 is less cohesive than a year ago. Base metals and AI hardware have broken in ways that warn on the cycle, but weakness has not spread to medium-term pattern and trend breakdowns in other markets. Base case is a continuation of the mid- to late-cycle regime through early 2027.

The sharp November risk-off has multiple markets near key support and deeply oversold. JPM will watch the rebound into early 2027 to decide whether late-2026 was a position reset in a continuing cycle or the start of a further correction.

Base metals have been a reliable leading indicator for the global manufacturing PMI. A regression on metals' 9m and 15m returns (r-squared 0.52, SE 2.2) plus the difficult year-ago base effect in 1Q27 point to a meaningful drop in the manufacturing PMI in early 2027, even with no further metals weakness.

S&P 500 base case holds above 6800-7000 support and below the post-GFC channel resistance, which sits at 8275 at end-December and 8655 by end-June. The 7000 area is the pivotal zone. A sustained break below 6800-7000 would likely signal a more persistent cyclical bear market.

S&P 500 oversold conditions are consistent with capitulation and often precede sharp rebounds. Initial rebounds should meet selling at 7300 and 7500. If a protracted correction develops in 1H27, 6150-6315 is major support (Mar 2026 trough, Feb 2025 peak, Oct 2022 38.2% retracement, roughly the 20% correction threshold).

AI hardware has corrected 35-40% at the index/basket level since early July. JPM's July 1 analog compares it with the 1999-2001 divergence between midstream and upstream infrastructure names. The group is judged broken until proven otherwise.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index broke the 10445-10895 May-Oct support zone, which is now resistance. Next support is 7692 (Apr 2025 61.8% retracement), then 5799-6500. The May-Oct top pattern has a 6500 measured move objective. Recovery into 11500-12000 would need a move back into the former range.

SOXL broke its rolling 240-day VWAP in late October. Past breaks of more than 3% below it saw 48% of the post-signal one-standard-error band in the money over the next three months, against 60% for random long entries.

Weakness began broadening to cyclical equities in mid-November. The 1999-2000 parallels include record equity concentration, rotation out of Tech, and a Fed tightening cycle. A difference is that the yield curve has not yet inverted. A sustained break below 2200 on the S&P 500 Value Index would be a meaningful bearish macro signal.

EURO STOXX 50 shows no medium-term distribution pattern. Support is 5753-5875, with channel support at 5750 in December rising to 5940 by end-1Q27. The Nikkei 225 and the CSI 300 have broken down. The Nikkei is negative below 62112 and 65427, and the CSI 300 has resistance at 4360-4440 and likely support at 3650-3850.

DM bonds keep a bearish medium-term bias after 2H26 range breaks. JPM expects broad ranges cheaper than the breakdown levels, not the aggressive pattern targets (30-year 6.00%/6.45%, 10-year 6.21%, 5-year 5.89%). Weakness spreading across risk markets and a sustained S&P break below 6800-7000 would risk a bullish whipsaw back into the 2023-2026 ranges.

US curves favor flattening into 2027. 2s/5s is expected to challenge about 0bp and may invert in early 2027, with targets at -12bp and -20bp. 2s/10s targets are 3-5.6bp and then -15bp, and 5s/30s targets are 18.5bp and then inversion. The 2s/5s/10s fly is expected to fall below -10/-12bp toward -17.5bp.
10-year TIPS breakevens are expected to stay range-bound through mid-2027. Support is 216-221bp and 206-208bp, with resistance at 230-233bp, 239-243bp and 250bp.
The 10-year Bund keeps a bearish bias while above 3.145-3.21% and 3.025%. The expected range sits in front of the 3.655% October high, rather than the 4.035% pattern objective.

DXY broke out of its 2025-2026 base above the 100 inflection, with targets at 104.489 or 104.59 (the report gives both) and 105.74, and a channel line of 106.30 in December falling to 105.30 by mid-year. The bias stays positive while DXY closes above 100. EUR/USD broke down, with next support at 1.0882, 1.0763 and channel support rising from 1.062 to 1.075.

GBP/USD is rangebound above 1.301-1.314 and a break lower would be a major bearish signal. AUD/USD broke 0.683-0.692 and is bearish below it, with next support at 0.6598 and 0.6436-0.6469. USD/JPY is the key confirmation pair, with a base case of 150-160 and a risk-scenario floor at 140. A break under 152.10-153.30 would confirm a head-and-shoulders top.

Copper (LME 3m) broke 13800-14050 support in November and fell through 12912-13187. Next support is 12288 and 12050, with major support at 11100-11200 and a likely 2027 floor near 11000. Iron ore is bearish below 93, with a 73.70 measured move objective.

Gold broke below the 3800-4000 support area. A sustained break below 4000 would turn the past year into a distribution pattern, with next support at 3400-3500, 3135 and 3044 and a mid-2000s measured move. Bulls need a close above 4147-4226 to gain traction, with 4500-4600 as the rebound target.

Brent: a break below 80 on the June contract would confirm a lasting downside reversal, with support at 70-72.5. The report also cites key support at 89 and resistance at 98.56-104.57. Channel support rises from 62.80 to 64.85 and channel resistance rises from 95.98-98.18 over the first half of 2027.

risk_factors: Broadening of weakness from AI hardware and base metals to cyclical equity groups.
A sustained S&P 500 break below 6800-7000, which would signal a more persistent cyclical bear market.
A sharp drop in the global manufacturing PMI in early 2027 given the metals signal.
A copper catch-down to other base metals.
A bullish whipsaw in DM bonds back into 2023-2026 ranges if risk markets keep weakening.
A 1999-2000 style transition from a tech unwind to a cyclical downturn.
A USD/JPY rejection at 158-160 opening downside toward 140.
charts_described: Figure 2 plots a Global manufacturing PMI regression forecast model using industrial and precious metals 9m and 15m returns with a 1-month lead (r-squared 0.52, SE 2.2).
Figure 9 shows the post-signal volatility adjusted one-standard deviation forecast cone for SOXL breaks below the 240-day VWAP against random long trades.
vol_and_positioning: The AI hardware unwind is described as an unwind of one of the most extreme periods of position concentration in the modern era.
The S&P 500 equal-weight versus cap-weighted correlation was the weakest since data begin in 1990, and the Technology sector had negative short-term correlation with most other segments.
A spike in correlation and implied volatility would likely push the US rates market to react more aggressively, which could support gold.
geopolitical: The war in the Middle East broke Crude out of its anticipated trading range in 1H26.
Continued geopolitical uncertainty complicates forecasting energy markets with a technical framework.

tension_points.bull_case: The S&P 500 holds above 6800-7000 support with a long-term channel intact. Oversold conditions resemble capitulation, and the yield curve is not inverted. Cyclical groups outside AI have not broken down.
tension_points.bear_case: AI hardware has fallen 35-40%, base metals and copper have broken, weakness is spreading to cyclicals, and the 1999-2000 analog suggests a tech unwind can turn into a cyclical bear market.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A sustained break below 6800-7000 on the S&P 500, or a sustained break below 2200 on the S&P 500 Value Index.

tension_points.bull_case: Bond charts favor yields staying cheaper than the 2H26 breakdown levels.
tension_points.bear_case: Continued risk-off would whip yields back into the 2023-2026 ranges.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A sustained S&P 500 break below 6800-7000 and spreading weakness across cyclical markets.

tension_points.bull_case: Gold holds the 3800-4000 area and rebounds toward 4500-4600 if a spike in correlation and volatility moves the rates market.
tension_points.bear_case: A sustained break below 4000 would confirm a multi-quarter head and shoulders top, with a transition to a multi-year bear cycle.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A bounce clearing 4147-4226 would invalidate the bearish pattern.
